config.label: Sets the minimum log level for output (e
config.description: Sets the minimum log level for output (e.g., 'debug', 'info', 'warn').

config.label: Cron expression for the KEV catalog conditional-refresh poll, on every transport
config.description: Cron expression for the KEV catalog conditional-refresh poll, on every transport. Set off to disable it; an invalid expression fails startup.

config.label: Filesystem path to the local SQLite index of ICS advisories
config.description: Filesystem path to the local SQLite index of ICS advisories. Unset, it is csaf.sqlite3 under cisa-cybersecurity-mcp-server in the per-user cache directory: ~/Library/Caches on macOS, $XDG_CACHE_HOME or ~/.cache on Linux, %LOCALAPPDATA% on Windows.

config.label: Seed the ICS advisory index in the background at startup when it has never completed a sync, and re-ingest it in place when an older server version built it
config.description: Seed the ICS advisory index in the background at startup when it has never completed a sync, and re-ingest it in place when an older server version built it. Accepts true or false; set false where seeding runs out of band.

config.label: Cron expression for the incremental ICS advisory refresh, on every transport; the refresh also runs once at startup
config.description: Cron expression for the incremental ICS advisory refresh, on every transport; the refresh also runs once at startup. Set off to disable both; an invalid expression fails startup.

config.label: Seconds a fetched SSVC record stays cached
config.description: Seconds a fetched SSVC record stays cached. Negative results use one sixth of this value.

config.label: Seconds a parsed RSS feed window stays cached
config.description: Seconds a parsed RSS feed window stays cached.

config.label: Per-request timeout in milliseconds for every upstream fetch
config.description: Per-request timeout in milliseconds for every upstream fetch.
